authority: sole repository authority for planned work, priorities, dependencies, blockers, and completion criteria

nodes.title: Focused atmospheric reference-value authority
nodes.summary: Shared conventional atmospheric defaults live in small immutable thermodynamic and geophysical authorities; domain kernels own narrow caller-overridable parameter records rather than duplicated literals or a global mutable configuration object.
completion: Thermodynamic and geophysical reference values have focused versioned authorities.
Dry thermodynamics, moist vapor algebra, and pressure hydrostatics source shared defaults from those authorities.
Cross-kernel witnesses prove default coherence and kernel-local override isolation.
Canonical source contains no second hardcoded authority for the shared Rd, cp, Rv, reference-pressure, or standard-gravity values.

nodes.title: Define layered runtime configuration contracts
nodes.summary: Keep immutable shared reference values, kernel parameters, experiment inputs, numerical policy, data-source configuration, and execution policy in separate focused ownership surfaces rather than duplicated literals or one flat global configuration object.
completion: Configuration schemas are grouped by semantic owner rather than one cross-system God object.
Reference values are immutable defaults and are not runtime configuration.
Kernel-local overrides do not mutate other components or global state.
Experiment configuration composes focused component records and records provenance without duplicating their definitions.

nodes.title: Deplete and delete legacy root monoliths
nodes.summary: Mine useful domain semantics from non-authoritative root prototypes into canonical code, contracts, tests, or another planning node, then delete the depleted source. Git history is the archive; the working tree does not keep compatibility monoliths merely for historical reference.
completion: No root-level climate_* scientific prototype remains.
No legacy-only compile lane or module-registry entry remains.
Every still-useful unmet semantic from removed prototypes is represented by a canonical contract, executable witness, or this planning graph.
Repository policy defines auditable mining and deletion criteria for future legacy depletion.

nodes.title: Recompose pressure-coordinate physics around authoritative fluxes
nodes.summary: Compose mass continuity, conservative tracer transport, pressure work, and energy exchange around the same authoritative carrier-mass flux with explicit geometry, area, layer-pressure thickness, gravity, and sign conventions.
completion: One coupling contract binds mass, tracer, continuity-divergence, and energy transport to the same carrier-mass flux.
Pressure-coordinate face-flux to divergence mapping has explicit dimensional and geometric inputs.
Manufactured or exact witnesses demonstrate coupled mass/tracer/energy consistency without inventing a generic horizontal-grid framework.

nodes.title: Define pressure, sigma, and hybrid vertical-coordinate semantics
nodes.summary: Extend the pressure-coordinate foundation with explicit sigma or hybrid-coordinate mapping only through declared coefficients, surface-pressure dependence, layer mass, orientation, and metric terms; old coefficient tables are not authority by themselves.
completion: Each supported vertical coordinate has explicit interface, unit, orientation, and layer-mass semantics.
Hybrid coefficients are supplied by a named dataset/model contract rather than copied from an unlabeled legacy table.
Mappings reduce to independently checkable pressure-coordinate cases where appropriate.

nodes.title: Establish physical parameterization seams and library boundaries
nodes.summary: Keep climate-owned equations, coupling semantics, and diagnostics local while delegating commodity radiation, remapping, integration, transforms, optimization, and linear algebra to mature libraries.
completion: Radiation, remapping, time integration, and generic linear-algebra boundaries name maintained production libraries and independent reference witnesses.
Boundary-layer, convection, microphysics, and component-exchange interfaces carry explicit units and owned budget terms before implementation expansion.
No generic solver or transform stack is promoted from deleted legacy prototypes.

nodes.title: Define typed physical-state boundaries
nodes.summary: Represent prognostic physical state, derived diagnostics, and experimental representations as distinct contracts with explicit units, coordinates, missingness, and initialization semantics.
completion: Physical fields cannot be silently initialized from synthetic observational defaults.
Experimental geometry or diagnostic artifacts do not inhabit authoritative prognostic state without an explicit adapter.
State-boundary fixtures cover missing, unavailable, and zero as distinct cases where scientifically relevant.

nodes.title: Define reproducible integration and restart state
nodes.summary: Specify the minimum climate-owned state required to reproduce an integration across restart boundaries while solver implementation, global scheduling, and resource arbitration remain external concerns.
completion: Restart identity binds physical state, time, focused configuration, solver identity, stochastic state, and required provenance.
A split-run witness agrees with an uninterrupted run within the declared numerical semantics.
Checkpoint format does not embed a second scheduler or generic integration framework.

nodes.title: Define library-backed numerical conditioning guardrails
nodes.summary: Separate numerical conditioning, refusal, and recovery diagnostics from scientific tipping interpretation, using maintained linear-algebra routines rather than project-local power iteration or fabricated fallback eigenvalues.
completion: Condition estimates and factorization failures come from declared maintained numerical backends or independent small reference oracles.
Unavailable or failed conditioning diagnostics remain unavailable or failed rather than receiving plausible fallback values.
Numerical guardrail thresholds are typed separately from empirical or policy thresholds.

nodes.title: Rebuild spectral and oscillation diagnostics from narrow contracts
nodes.summary: Define scientifically narrow spectra, coherence, wavelet, climate-index, and oscillation diagnostics around maintained transform/statistics libraries rather than omnibus placeholder algorithms.
completion: Each diagnostic names its input sampling, normalization, units, missing-data semantics, and independent benchmark.
FFT and standard transform machinery use maintained libraries in production paths.
Forecast-skill or named climate-index outputs cannot be synthesized by arbitrary fallback formulas.

nodes.title: Ground feedback diagnostics in explicit observations and process definitions
nodes.summary: Ground feedback diagnostics in explicit observations and process definitions. Trajectory/secant diagnostics remain path-dependent numerical quantities unless an experiment identifies a causal or partial feedback derivative through controlled variables, explicit radiative fields, provenance, uncertainty, and competing process explanations.
completion: Any albedo-temperature finite-difference quantity is reported as a trajectory/secant diagnostic unless the experiment design identifies the variables and controls required for a causal or partial feedback derivative.
Each feedback diagnostic declares measured variables, aggregation, units, time base, uncertainty, and missing-data handling.
Process-specific thresholds are either empirically sourced with domain of applicability or typed as experiment policy rather than physical truth.
Benchmarks retain observational provenance and compare against simpler trend or regression diagnostics.
Empirical adapters consume provenance-bearing observed fields with registered source identity and artifact digest; raw numeric samples are not an observational evidence boundary.

Radiative feedback conversion is unavailable unless a source-backed shortwave field is resolved with a definition, aggregation, spatial domain, and time base matched to the albedo diagnostic; no scalar forcing substitute is permitted.
Synthetic controls remain explicitly synthetic and cannot satisfy empirical benchmark completion criteria.

nodes.title: Verify model-selection criteria under climate dependence
nodes.summary: Use maintained statistical implementations or transparent formula references to test information criteria and model comparisons under autocorrelation, spatial dependence, effective sample size, and held-out climate tasks.
completion: Criterion formulas have fixture-based reference witnesses.
Dependence assumptions and effective-sample-size treatment are explicit in every climate use.
Model comparison is separated from downstream physical interpretation.

nodes.title: Externalize hardcoded climate data and assumptions
nodes.summary: Audit canonical data, values, empirical assumptions, thresholds, coefficient tables, climatologies, and metadata so externally owned information comes from authoritative downloaded datasets or versioned APIs, while true reference constants, numerical policy, experiment policy, and caller-owned model parameters remain explicitly local.
completion: Canonical and experiment-facing hardcoded climate data, empirical constants, thresholds, coefficient tables, climatologies, geographic or station metadata, and other externally owned assumptions are inventoried with usage sites and ownership class.

Each externally owned item is bound to a primary authoritative dataset or API, or explicitly rejected with rationale; retrieval identity, version or time coverage, units, licensing or access constraints, and update semantics are recorded.
At least one downloaded immutable dataset path and one live or versioned API path are exercised through provenance-preserving adapters with network-free fixtures.

Values that remain local are justified as mathematical or reference constants, numerical policy, experiment policy, or caller-owned model parameters rather than silently acting as observational truth.

A usage marked current and externalized names a concrete implementation authority boundary, names an executable repository witness for that boundary, and cannot coexist with implicit Default/fallback constructors on that surface.

Configuration records claiming literature-fixed, calibrated, or learned provenance resolve their authority references to the registered source authority rather than relying on provenance labels alone.

nodes.title: Create one immutable observational or reanalysis projection
nodes.summary: Build a narrow CF-aware data projection with explicit retrieval identity, QC, missingness, transformation lineage, coordinates, units, and content digests before expanding acquisition breadth.
completion: One real dataset projection is reproducible from immutable source identity through preprocessing to experiment input.
Missing observations are never silently replaced by climatology or defaults in validation paths.
A compact network-free fixture exercises the same schema and transformation semantics in CI.

nodes.title: Define narrow versioned array FFI contracts
nodes.summary: Cross-language adapters expose only implemented backends with explicit dtype, shape, layout, ownership, lifetime, error, and capability-discovery semantics.
completion: FFI schemas make array ownership and memory layout unambiguous.
Unavailable language backends fail capability discovery instead of returning placeholder array descriptors.
Round-trip fixtures cover each advertised backend.

nodes.title: Exercise read-only Commons execution lineage
nodes.summary: Run one sandboxed Climate experiment through Commons while preserving run, trace, causation, build, artifact, and evidence identity without creating a second scheduler in Climate.
blockers: The executable R4 witness is committed, but completion still requires the machine-local Commons scheduler state cutover/daemon and one successful commons_live_witness.py run against that real daemon.
completion: One real read-only or sandboxed execution preserves Climate scientific semantics and end-to-end lineage.
Climate owns only local numerical scheduling and checkpoint semantics; global resource arbitration remains external.

nodes.title: Verify nonlinear coordinate covariance
nodes.summary: Extend independent geometry verification to a nonlinear coordinate transformation including the inhomogeneous Christoffel transformation term.
completion: A nonlinear analytic fixture has independently generated transformed metric and Christoffel quantities.
Canonical geometry agrees within scale-aware tolerances and detects an intentionally omitted inhomogeneous term.

nodes.title: Add a second independent metric-derivative route
nodes.summary: A pinned JAX jacfwd reference route now independently differentiates the shared analytic metric fixtures and agrees with exact SymPy first/second derivatives in FP64; derivative failures remain fail-closed and precision identity is explicit.
completion: At least two materially independent derivative-generation routes agree on shared analytic fixtures.
Conditioning and derivative-estimation failures remain explicit diagnostics rather than repaired tensors.

nodes.title: Test multirepresentation structure against simpler baselines
nodes.summary: Use structural-worlds-v1 and multirepresentation_worlds.py as the sole authority for world relationships, observation maps, and shared-target semantics. Static evaluation is byte-bound to that authority, uses separately seeded confirmation worlds, calibrated abstention, existing PCA/CCA/spectral/JSF plus factor analysis, and a common downstream probe for raw/PCA/CCA/factor representations. The role-based temporal extension now has an explicit PyDMD state-space baseline using the same discovery-fitted representation transforms and separately seeded confirmation trajectories. Maintained dimension/topology-selection witnesses and fuller structural relationship selection remain open.
completion: Synthetic systems distinguish shared, private, coupled, quotient/noninjective, stratified, nuisance-dominated, and null structure with immutable known ground truth and explicit identifiability limits.
Candidate methods are evaluated for both recovery and calibrated abstention across the full world suite; no method is required to emit a structure when the observation model cannot identify one.
Candidate geometry is compared against raw concatenation, PCA/CCA, graph, state-space, independence/testing, and standard latent-representation baselines with matched information.
Dimension selection and topology claims use maintained linear algebra/statistics and mathematically exact invariants rather than local power iteration or heuristic thresholds.
Confirmation seeds/world variants are isolated from discovery/tuning so a successful structural classifier cannot be credited for fixture memorization.

nodes.title: Validate information-geometry primitives on explicit statistical models
nodes.summary: Preregistered Normal-family discovery and a fresh 16-trial two-layer EBM confirmation now compare local Fisher natural gradient against strong conventional curvature-aware baselines under explicit Gaussian observations and held-out forcing histories. The confirmation found equivalent recovery/held-out likelihood to Jacobian-scaled TRF, no distinct Fisher-specific advantage under the frozen rule, and numerical Fisher/Gauss-Newton step equivalence.
completion: Synthetic observations are explicit experiment inputs rather than hidden inside method implementations.
Parameter-recovery and held-out likelihood tasks compare natural-gradient behavior against standard optimizers and equally informed preconditioners.

nodes.title: Realize scale-native climate-data sheaf semantics
nodes.summary: Build climate-data sheaf semantics on the actual production path: provider-neutral station identity and chunked observations, global geodesic locality, sparse/matrix-free restrictions and cochains, deterministic partition ownership, and scalable gluing/nullspace operations. Tiny fixtures exercise this path but cannot substitute for it.
completion: Provider-backed fixtures enter the same provider-neutral StationCatalog and StationSection contracts intended for large station networks.
Station locality uses global geodesic semantics with indexed neighbor discovery, deterministic shard ownership, and no global projected-CRS assumption or all-pairs scan.
Canonical restriction operators and degree-zero coboundaries are sparse or matrix-free; dense global cochain matrices are not an execution prerequisite.
Canonical higher-dimensional climate restrictions satisfy identity/composition and sparse consecutive coboundaries satisfy d_(k+1) o d_k = 0.
Global-section compatibility and nullspace/gluing operations have a sparse or matrix-free solver path whose memory scales with partitions and local incidence rather than a dense global matrix.
Reference finite-complex machinery remains an independent mathematical oracle and cannot by itself satisfy production climate-data realization.

nodes.title: Ground multirepresentation weighting in real cost and noise authority
nodes.summary: Move beyond equal-cost synthetic observation design only when real acquisition cost, noise, provenance, and missingness authorities exist; do not tune representation weights to downstream scores in their absence.
blockers: Requires a real dataset with defensible observation-cost and noise metadata.
completion: Observation-design objectives use externally grounded cost/noise data rather than arbitrary scalar weights.
Fast/slow modal information, Fisher rank, and acquisition cost remain separate reported objectives unless a decision policy explicitly combines them.

nodes.title: Test climate encodings for exact ultrametric primitives
nodes.summary: Keep exact p-adic mathematics separate from the empirical hypothesis that a climate encoding improves teleconnection tasks, and compare against generic hierarchy, graph, spectral, Euclidean, learned, and randomized controls.
completion: Encoding choices are preregistered without target leakage.
Held-out tasks attribute any gain to the encoding rather than to unequal information access or arbitrary geographic weighting.

nodes.title: Give Clifford representations a falsifiable climate task
nodes.summary: Evaluate canonical Clifford algebra representations on a declared multicomponent or oriented-dynamics task against complex spectra, Hilbert phase, wavelets, bispectra, and DMD/Koopman baselines.
completion: The Clifford representation is mathematically canonical for the declared signature and dimension.
Incremental task value is measured against simpler phase/spectral representations with matched information.

nodes.title: Separate climate feasibility from modal truth
nodes.summary: Construct climate-specific worlds, propositions, and accessibility relations through an explicit adapter while keeping canonical Kripke satisfaction semantics independent of heuristic plausibility scores.
completion: Physical feasibility construction has explicit data/model provenance and no hidden probability interpretation.
Modal truth tests consume only the declared finite frame and valuation produced by the adapter.

nodes.title: Separate approximate climate symmetry diagnostics from exact Noether structure
nodes.summary: Use exact variational-symmetry references as mathematical authority and evaluate approximate climate symmetry indicators as diagnostics with explicit baselines rather than conservation-law claims.
completion: Exact conservation-law language is reserved for witnessed variational symmetries.
Approximate symmetry diagnostics have declared tasks, scales, uncertainty, and conventional comparison methods.

nodes.title: Isolate climate-specific optimization objectives
nodes.summary: The two-layer EBM recovery likelihood now has an isolated climate-owned objective/constraint module for temperature observation mapping, fixed-variance Gaussian residual/likelihood semantics, positive log-parameter coordinates, and common bounds, while SciPy owns generic TRF/L-BFGS-B optimization. Independent objective tests and the preregistered 16-trial recovery confirmation verify the boundary under equivalent information and frozen stopping rules.
completion: Climate-owned objective/constraint contracts are independently testable without a local generic optimizer stack.
Benchmark and recovery experiments compare maintained optimizers under equivalent information and stopping rules.

nodes.title: Prepare GPU differential execution only for a justified workload
nodes.summary: Accelerate a geometry or representation workload only after profiling establishes a real bottleneck; generic device linear algebra and transforms use vendor libraries and execution identity remains fail closed.
blockers: Requires a scientifically useful workload with a demonstrated CPU/reference bottleneck.
Hardware correctness and performance claims require an actual CUDA device.
completion: CPU/reference fixtures and stage-level tolerances exist before device optimization.
Real-device tests cover execution identity, conditioning, determinism, transfers, VRAM, and differential agreement.
No compatibility shim can satisfy a requested CUDA/NCCL/tensor-core identity.

nodes.title: Federate freely accessible worldwide station observations
nodes.summary: Build an extensible station-data federation whose target population is every station worldwide that can be lawfully and reproducibly accessed without paid data access. GHCN-Daily and GHCNh share provider-neutral identity, bounded adaptive catalog shards, manifest, coverage, and canonical sheaf/topology substrate. Current station revisions keep one provider-location snapshot per alias; coverage v2 exposes bounded geography; catalog refreshes are append-only and idempotent for exact shard-id continuity, superseding changed shard content while refusing to infer deletion/renaming until explicit catalog-retirement semantics exist.
completion: Provider discovery and registration is extensible and records access, licensing, update, and revision semantics rather than embedding a closed hand-selected station list.

Every ingested station has a stable canonical identity plus provider aliases and location/history metadata; cross-provider deduplication is explicit and reversible rather than proximity-only guessing.
Observation storage is immutable/versioned and partitioned by bounded dimensions such as provider, time, variable, and spatial shard so no workflow requires all stations or all times in memory.

Incremental ingestion is idempotent from immutable captured artifacts, records source revisions or tombstones and artifact digests, and preserves provider quality/source flags without silent imputation; transport failure itself creates no accepted Climate artifact.
Coverage manifests expose station, variable, temporal, geographic, and provider availability so gaps are observable rather than hidden by defaults.
Additional freely accessible station authorities can enter without changing canonical sheaf topology/operator interfaces or adding provider-specific branches to numerical kernels.

nodes.title: Exercise sheaf substrate at worldwide station scale
nodes.summary: Run the canonical sparse/local sheaf substrate over the federated worldwide free-station catalog and granular multi-year observation partitions, demonstrating bounded-memory partition equivalence and useful higher-order local-to-global structure without changing implementation identity.
completion: Worldwide station topology is constructed from the canonical indexed geodesic locality path with no all-pairs or powerset construction.
Observation processing spans granular multi-year partitions without loading the full station-by-time tensor into memory.
Partitioned or sharded residual and cochain results agree with single-partition fixtures under the declared equivalence relation.

Peak RSS, wall time, station vertices, search radius, edge count, requested simplex degree, local clique density, variables, and observation chunk size are measured so sparse edge accumulation or higher-simplex construction cannot hide a combinatorial memory bottleneck.
Higher-order sheaf operations used at this scale execute through sparse or matrix-free backends and fail explicitly when resource envelopes are exceeded.

nodes.title: Run one contract-valid CPU experiment end to end
nodes.summary: Provide a narrow canonical local runtime that proves the common research spine by resolving registered experiments, methods, immutable datasets, and configuration; executing baseline/candidate processes; and emitting content-addressed artifacts, typed metrics, exact execution receipts, and contract-valid outcomes without manufacturing scientific evidence or treating transient runner artifacts as durable authority.
completion: The runtime resolves method descriptors and refuses unknown or non-runnable requested methods rather than substituting another implementation.
The EBM fixture and numerical configuration are verified against immutable content digests before execution.

Baseline and candidate execute as distinct subprocess identities with exact commands, repository revision, environment/library versions, stdout/stderr digests, and generated source-bound build identities recorded.
Artifacts and metric results are JSON-portable, content-addressed, and represent rank deficiency explicitly rather than using NaN, Infinity, regularization, or sentinels.

RunManifest and ExperimentOutcome outputs pass the CUE contract in the executing environment; Generated receipts remain ephemeral unless a committed identity or explicitly declared immutable external store provides durable persistence.
No EvidenceRecord is emitted for this structural control until a claim mapping is declared; successful execution alone does not strengthen a scientific claim.

nodes.title: Build a climate-representation benchmark ladder
nodes.summary: Complete immutable two-layer EBM representation benchmark ladder spanning exact forcing controls, discovery-trained OOD closure, sparse/noisy and exactly redundant observations, local parameter degeneracy/identifiability, seeded internal variability with climate-statistics preservation, and a simple regime-dependent feedback control. State reconstruction, forced response, parameter sensitivity, statistics preservation, and OOD behavior remain separate metric families and every executable rung uses the common run/artifact/metric spine without manufacturing claim evidence.
completion: Exact piecewise-affine forcing protocols reduce to the existing constant-forcing solution, preserve the energy budget, and expose immutable discovery/confirmation forcing domains through the common runtime.
At least one fitted representation is trained only on discovery-domain trajectories and evaluated on held-out step, ramp, overshoot/reversal, and sign-reversal forcing without confirmation leakage.

Subsequent immutable benchmark versions add sparse/noisy observations, deliberately redundant channels, parameter degeneracies, stochastic internal variability, and a simple regime-dependent feedback without mutating prior fixture semantics.

Tasks separately score state reconstruction, forced-response estimation, parameter identifiability, climate-statistics preservation, and out-of-distribution response; no single aggregate score substitutes for those distinctions.
Every rung emits common run/artifact/metric records and may produce scientific evidence only when a claim-scoped experiment explicitly licenses it.

nodes.title: Compose physical kernels through a streaming budget ledger
nodes.summary: Make conservation/balance accounting a common streaming sidecar rather than kernel-specific diagnostics. Extensive quantities use one signed ledger across boundaries, resolved sources/sinks, internal and coupling exchanges, numerical corrections, solver residual effects, and roundoff; partition merges must preserve accounting semantics without materializing global state.
completion: A canonical extensive-quantity ledger exposes typed process classes, explicit sign semantics, compensated accumulation, partition merging, uncertainty bounds, and an unexplained residual without repair or hidden balancing.
Duplicate partitions and incompatible quantity/domain/time identities fail closed before accumulation.
Carrier mass, tracer mass, pressure/thermodynamic energy exchange, and at least one dissipative operator emit or adapt into the common ledger using their existing authoritative process semantics.
A coupled witness shows internal exchanges cancel for the declared mathematical reason while legitimate boundary forcing, dissipation, and numerical corrections remain separately visible.

Partitioned and unpartitioned accounting agree within declared floating-point tolerance, and the accounting path requires memory proportional to process identities plus partition metadata rather than global field size.

nodes.title: Evaluate external model artifacts through Climate-owned tasks
nodes.summary: Bind immutable external model artifacts to Climate-owned evaluation specifications through the artifact's native runtime or an exact native-output import path, then map the resulting receipt into Climate/Commons evidence semantics without building a parallel model-serving stack or allowing the exchange layer to make producer-repository promotion decisions.
blockers: Climate now has an exact native-output import validator bound to subject, runtime version, configuration, transformations, prediction bytes, and failed-run semantics. Completion still requires the unresolved Commons R4 dependency and one real producer-side Training runtime output/receipt evaluated through that integrated path.
completion: A versioned Climate evaluation specification declares the external artifact contract, native execution/import identity, climate task, metrics, controls, resource class, and falsifiers.
The external artifact is referenced by full SHA-256 exchange identity while retaining producer-local aliases only as metadata.

One Commons-scheduled Climate evaluation consumes predictions produced by the artifact's native runtime or an exact native-output import path and emits a contract-valid evaluation attestation with immutable subject binding and Climate run/artifact lineage.

The integration receipt binds native runtime/tool version, artifact/checkpoint identity, relevant configuration, execution failure semantics, and transformations without reproducing upstream training/inference/serving machinery.
The attestation carries evidence class and verification separately and cannot encode producer-repository acceptance/promotion.

nodes.title: Persist structured provenance for failed experiment execution
nodes.summary: Close the gap between the run contract and runtime behavior so nonzero subprocess exits and invalid method output materialize a durable, contract-valid ineligible run receipt before control is surfaced as an error. Scientific falsification remains a successful execution with attacking/inconclusive evidence; infrastructure or execution failure is recorded separately.
completion: Subprocess execution always captures command, start/end time, exit code, stdout/stderr digests, and available environment identity before interpreting success or failure.

When experiment/method/input identity is sufficiently resolved, nonzero exits or malformed method output emit a contract-valid ineligible RunManifest with scientific_output_eligible=false before the runtime raises or returns failure.
Failure records distinguish execution stage and typed infrastructure/input/configuration failure from a scientifically attacking metric result.
Negative witnesses cover missing implementation/dependency, nonzero exit, and invalid JSON without losing the failure receipt.

nodes.title: Close one claim-to-evidence scientific loop
nodes.summary: Exercise the epistemic architecture end to end on one narrowly scoped existing claim using a preregistered claim mapping, baselines, controls, immutable run receipts, metrics, threat analysis, and an explicit supporting, attacking, or inconclusive evidence record. A null or attacking result satisfies the architecture more honestly than manufacturing a positive result.
completion: One existing claim names a versioned claim-scoped experiment or evaluation mapping before execution.
Baseline, candidate, negative controls, falsifiers, and acceptance/attack interpretation are fixed before confirmation execution.

The resulting runs bind exact ExperimentSpec, transitive method-source closure, datasets/configuration, environment, commands, artifacts, and either a verified checkout revision/dirty state or an explicitly identified immutable source bundle.
At least one EvidenceRecord is registered with verification status, relation, scope, threats to validity, metric lineage, and run/artifact identity; an attacking or inconclusive record is acceptable.
Claim maturity changes only if its declared evidence requirements are actually satisfied; successful execution alone cannot promote the claim.

nodes.title: Decompose experiment runtime into composable execution protocols
nodes.summary: After one complete claim/evidence vertical slice exposes the stable seams, separate generic experiment resolution, method execution, receipt materialization, and metric/evaluator protocols from experiment-family logic so new experiments become primarily declarative without hiding scientific semantics in a universal plugin framework.
completion: Generic resolution/execution/receipt phases no longer grow one large branch per experiment ID.
Family-specific scientific evaluation remains explicit, narrow, and independently testable rather than being folded into generic orchestration.
Adding a structurally similar experiment requires declarative identities/configuration plus a small evaluator registration rather than a 150-200 line duplicated adapter.
Existing EBM outcomes and receipts remain byte/semantic compatible where the contract does not intentionally version.

nodes.title: Resolve a complete repository verification environment
nodes.summary: Retain focused per-experiment dependency slices while adding one resolved environment identity capable of running the complete verification suite from a clean checkout, including Python, Rust, Fortran/LAPACK, CUE, and numerical-library versions.
completion: A clean checkout can reproduce the complete Python/architecture test environment from a lock, hermetic environment, or immutable container identity.
Rust verification uses a committed dependency lock appropriate to the repository's application/test role.
Fortran compiler and LAPACK/BLAS provider identity are recorded for verification runs.
Evidence-eligible experiment receipts record the resolved environment/container identity rather than only hand-authored top-level dependency pins.

nodes.title: Define uncertainty-aware sheaf observation compatibility
nodes.summary: Keep exact global-section/restriction equality as the algebraic reference control while introducing a distinct observation-uncertainty method for noisy station data with explicit units, covariance/weights, residual semantics, and falsifiable interpretation rather than silent floating tolerances.
completion: Exact sheaf compatibility remains unchanged as the mathematical/reference method.
A separate uncertainty-aware method declares observation units, covariance or precision assumptions, missingness, and residual statistic.
Synthetic injected-noise/fault controls verify calibration and compare against ordinary residual/QC baselines.
No tolerance-based approximate section is interpreted as an exact global section or cohomology statement.

nodes.title: Separate logical observation identity from storage realization
nodes.summary: Promote the existing logical-content digest versus Parquet/fragments/materialization distinction into an explicit data identity contract so scientifically equivalent observation content can retain stable identity across storage rewrites while physical realizations remain independently content-addressed.
completion: Logical observation content identity is explicit in the provider-neutral partition/publication contract rather than only nested in a storage manifest.
Physical materialization identity separately binds format, compression, library/version, fragments, and bytes.
Tests show equivalent logical records can preserve logical identity across a changed Parquet realization while corruption or changed observations alter the appropriate identity.

nodes.title: Make neighborhood geometry a first-class representation evaluator
nodes.summary: Promote k-nearest-neighbor relations from an implicit substrate of spectral embedding, JSF kernels, mutual-information estimation, and downstream kNN probes into an implementation-independent evaluation layer. Establish neighborhood preservation, cross-view consensus, perturbation stability, nuisance retention, and dynamic-neighbor behavior on controlled worlds before adding UMAP as one discovery-fitted nonlinear baseline; visualization alone is never evidence.
completion: A method-independent neighborhood evaluator defines exact neighbor sets over a preregistered range of k and reports directional precision/recall or overlap rather than selecting one flattering neighborhood size.

Trustworthiness and complementary continuity or missing-neighbor diagnostics are implemented with explicit reference spaces and are validated on known structural worlds independently of any candidate method objective.
Cross-view consensus-neighbor recovery measures whether a candidate representation preferentially preserves relationships shared by both views rather than modality-specific or nuisance neighborhoods.

Neighborhood stability is evaluated under separately seeded realizations and declared perturbations such as observation noise, missingness, training subsampling, and small method-hyperparameter changes.

UMAP, if registered, is fit only on discovery data and uses its maintained out-of-sample transform for confirmation data; two-dimensional visual separation is diagnostic only and cannot satisfy scientific evidence criteria.

EBM extensions distinguish Euclidean, physically weighted, observation/information-geometric, and dynamical neighborhood notions only where each metric has an explicit authority and units; dynamic-neighbor divergence under true forcing is reported separately from static embedding quality.
No neighborhood-derived quantity is connected to climate.geometry.regime_indicator until controlled worlds show correct behavior and incremental information beyond simpler registered diagnostics.

nodes.title: Bind external native capabilities without shadow implementations
nodes.summary: Bind externally owned capabilities through exact native identity, configuration, transformation, receipt, and failure semantics. Static adapters and boundary checks may be realized locally, but production-scale native capabilities can authorize pruning only after a non-hosted execution produces a durable receipt or evaluation artifact through the interface that will remain in use.
completion: Each realized external integration names the exact native capability being consumed, the Climate-owned semantic gap it fills, and the upstream identity/configuration/receipt required for reproducibility.

Adapters preserve native artifact/model/data identity and failure semantics and map only necessary outputs into existing Climate run/artifact/metric/evidence records rather than defining a second generic execution or data model.
Architecture tests contain at least one negative witness showing that an unavailable or mismatched native capability fails closed rather than selecting a local substitute with the same identity.

A local shadow is deleted or narrowed only in the same capability lineage after the named external replacement has executed successfully against a production-scale resource through the interface that will remain in use.

Sample-only, credential-gated, private-only, or failing native paths cannot satisfy a pruning gate; their blockers remain explicit planning state rather than being replaced by a different implementation.
Any retained local duplicate is justified as an independently valuable bounded reference or a concrete missing upstream semantic, with a distinct implementation identity.

nodes.title: Make cross-model evidence transport explicit and testable
nodes.summary: Represent how evidence from idealized models, learned emulators, parent GCMs, model ensembles, reanalysis, and observations may inform one claim without treating those sources as interchangeable or allowing agreement at one fidelity to silently promote another.
completion: A versioned evaluation example records evidence source/model class, domain of validity, and the explicit bridge object or assumption used when evidence informs a claim beyond its producing model.
Negative witnesses reject automatic promotion from emulator agreement to parent-GCM validation and from multimodel agreement to observational support.
At least one bridge test compares a declared transferable object such as an intervention response, invariant, response subspace, or representation relation across two model classes.
Evidence records preserve each source's original class and scope even when several sources are synthesized for one claim.

nodes.title: Use cheap model exploration to choose discriminating high-fidelity experiments
nodes.summary: Test the core frontier hypothesis that emulator-scale exploration plus response/information geometry can identify a small set of high-fidelity interventions that discriminate mechanisms or reduce uncertainty more efficiently than simple grid/random designs, while preserving native execution ownership at every fidelity.
completion: One matched intervention family is executable or importable through a cheap learned/idealized model and a higher-fidelity physical-model path with exact native receipts.
The cheap path estimates a predeclared response/discrepancy/information structure and freezes a high-fidelity experiment-selection rule before high-fidelity outcomes are inspected.
The same expensive-run budget is allocated to at least one simple comparator such as random, space-filling, or conventional sensitivity selection.
Evaluation reports response-operator or target-discrimination agreement, discrepancy structure, uncertainty reduction, and failure cases separately from ordinary fieldwise error.
Any evidence update remains scoped to the high-fidelity observations actually run; cheap-model exploration is recorded as experiment-design evidence rather than substituted confirmation.

nodes.title: Use Climate-REF on production CMIP data
nodes.summary: The Climate-REF production CMIP path is specified, but completion requires a new non-hosted execution against the production CMIP6 object with a durable committed or explicitly immutable receipt. No such durable receipt is registered after hosted CI was removed as an execution authority.
completion: A real object from the production CMIP6 ESGF archive is retrieved with an expected SHA-256 digest.
Climate-REF is pinned to an exact upstream revision and ingests the object through its native CMIP6 DRS path.
The resulting native catalog resolves the model and variable identity without Climate implementing a parallel CMIP catalog.
Future CMIP catalog/ingest pruning may rely on this owner path only where the local code overlaps this exact capability.

nodes.title: Use the public AIMIP production archive
nodes.summary: The public AIMIP archive identity and assay are specified, but completion requires a new non-hosted full-archive execution with the immutable revision, selected object path, digest, and bounded diagnostic preserved in a durable receipt. No such durable receipt is registered.
completion: A public full AIMIP archive snapshot resolves to an immutable upstream revision, and the selected object path is discovered from that exact snapshot rather than guessed or silently substituted.
A real full-period model field is downloaded with a recorded SHA-256 digest, opened, and used for at least one bounded Climate diagnostic.
The receipt binds AIMIP organization, model, experiment, realization, frequency, variable, grid, version, immutable archive revision, and exact object path.
Missing variables or realizations fail the declared assay or define a separately preregistered partial experiment; they are never filled or substituted silently.
Only after this native archive path passes may overlapping local AI-intercomparison/archive behavior be pruned.

nodes.title: Use ESMValCore production preprocessing
nodes.summary: The pinned ESMValCore preprocessing path remains specified, but durable completion requires the production CMIP owner path to be re-established first and a new non-hosted native preprocessing receipt to be committed or stored immutably.
completion: The exact pinned ESMValCore source revision imports under its documented dependency environment, including ESMPy.
Native ESMValCore preprocessing executes on the checksum-pinned production CMIP6 object and exits cleanly.
Input selection, preprocessing operation, upstream revision and output identity are recorded.
Only capabilities demonstrated by that passing native path may authorize deletion of overlapping Climate preprocessing.
blockers: Blocked on a new non-hosted production CMIP owner-path receipt plus a native ESMValCore preprocessing receipt; the removed hosted run is not durable authority.

nodes.title: Use AQUA production data access
nodes.summary: The pinned AQUA reader path remains specified, but durable completion requires the production CMIP owner path to be re-established first and a new non-hosted native reader receipt to be committed or stored immutably.
completion: The exact pinned AQUA revision reads the production object through its native NetCDF/Reader surface.
A Climate-required bounded computation completes and the process exits normally with no native-library abort.
Reader configuration, upstream revision, source digest and output identity are bound.
Only after a clean native run may overlapping Climate generic reader/catalog/regrid/output behavior be pruned.
blockers: Blocked on a new non-hosted production CMIP owner-path receipt plus a native AQUA reader receipt; the removed hosted run is not durable authority.

nodes.title: Resolve Commons storage distribution for public Climate consumption
nodes.summary: Use Commons as the exact owner of durable content-addressed persistence before deleting Climate station-publication storage mechanics, but only through a legitimate distribution boundary that public Climate consumers can access without repository-secret coupling.
blockers: Commons is private while Climate is public. A direct Cargo Git dependency on the pinned Commons revision failed from the public Climate context because the private repository requires authentication. Copying/vendoring the Commons implementation or embedding credentials in Climate is not an acceptable substitute.
completion: Commons exposes a legitimate versioned distribution surface consumable by public Climate users/environments without repository-secret coupling or copied implementation code.
Climate executes that exact owner implementation in an explicitly provisioned integrated environment and verifies content identity, idempotence and failure semantics.
Station partition encoding remains Climate-specific while durable object persistence is delegated to Commons.
Only after the owner path passes are data/ncei_ghcnd_parquet.py or data/ncei_ghcnh_partition.py storage-engine mechanics eligible for pruning.

nodes.title: Turn included Codespaces CPU into receipted experiments
nodes.summary: Codespaces execution is deliberately disabled until a finite self-budget is explicitly configured. Climate tracks its own initiated usage independently of provider billing: every campaign requires a committed reservation for cores, wall time, core-minutes and storage; the full reservation is charged before execution; bootstrap and runtime fail closed without it; and one unreconciled reservation blocks another campaign.
completion: The repository-side finite-resource ledger enables Codespaces only with an explicit budget period and positive hard self-limits for core-minutes and storage GiB-hours.
Every Climate-initiated Codespaces use is reserved in the durable ledger before provisioning/bootstrap; the full reservation counts against remaining self-budget and overcommit fails closed.

Bootstrap claims exactly one authorization before dependency installation, binds it to the Codespace, and the campaign enforces its wall-time deadline while discovering experiments from the canonical runtime/spec registry.

A clean-main campaign records stdout/stderr, run/outcome artifacts, CUE logs, environment identity, Codespace identity, detected cores, actual wall seconds, rounded actual core-minutes, reserved/charged core-minutes and storage, and filesystem usage.

Only one unreconciled authorization may exist; another campaign is forbidden until the prior durable ledger entry is completed from its resource receipt. Actual early finish does not silently refund reserved capacity.
Codespaces remains only an R1/R2 venue; CUDA, native integrated runtimes and large-data obligations remain resource-gated, and redundant quota-burning repetition is prohibited.
blockers: architecture/finite_resource_ledger.json currently keeps github_codespaces disabled with zero self-budget. No Codespaces campaign may be initiated until an explicit finite self-budget and one committed authorization are supplied.
